VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) shows 58 tests pass, and the package.json diff (ATT) confirms no dependency changes—satisfying criterion (2) and the test-passing portion of (1). However, criterion (1) requires that "the bug is fixed," and there is no admissible evidence that the existing test suite actually covers the rounding-drift defect. Passing tests only demonstrate the bug is fixed if a test reproduces it; absent that, the self-report's claim of a fix rests on SELF-class provenance, which is insufficient. Without proof that a regression test exercises the netting rounding path, criterion (1) is not established.
